evidence.section: 3.3 The influence of Ti addition on the Co-30Ni-10Al-5Cr-2Ta alloy
evidence.quote: Figs. 4(a-c) show the microstructural comparison of Co30Ni, Co30Ni2Ti and Co30Ni4Ti alloys, respectively after aging at 900 °C for 50 hours.

Alloy ingots weighing 100 grams of nominal composition (all in at. %) Co-xNi-10Al-5Cr-2Ta-yTi (x = 0, 10, 20, 30, y = 0 and x = 30, y = 2, 4) were prepared using constituent elements of 4N purity in vacuum arc melting unit under argon inert atmosphere using a tungsten electrode and a water cooled copper hearth. The alloys were melted 8-10 times with flipping of the button after each melting cycle to ensure homogeneity throughout the ingot.
The prepared ingots were cast into rods (Φ-3mm, L-80mm) using vacuum suction casting unit under argon atmosphere using a water-cooled split copper mold.
The cast samples were solutionized at 1200 °C for 20 hours in a vacuum tube furnace (10^-5 mbar) followed by water quenching.
These were aged at 800 °C for 0 to 50 h for the alloy compositions with x = 0, 10 and 20 and at 900 °C for 0 to 1000 h for rest of the alloys followed by water quenching.
